messages:
sarah: Starting prod deploy in ~5m for v2-routing tweak. @oliver @tara - you're on post-deploy smoke. I'll kick off canary now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started (canary-id: c-4821). initial traffic: 10%.

oliver: On watch. dashboards up, I'll report any anomalies at 2m.

tara: Ready with quick smoke checklist — running auth + sample flows after canary warms.

sarah: Smoke checklist (quick):
- `GET /health` on web proxy
- `POST /v2/infer` sample prompt (5 tokens)
- check /chat 95th latency
- error-rate by model and by region

oliver: `GET /health` frontend = 200, inference service = 200, sample returned expected JSON.

tara: Ran sample prompts against canary. latency +~20ms vs baseline but p95 within SLO. no 5xx.

deploy-bot: Canary advanced to 50% after 5m (canary-id: c-4821).

mike: Heads up — seeing small bump in Redis write ops and higher cache evictions. digging into cache_ttl change that shipped with the rollout.

sarah: Hold full rollout while we validate cache behavior. rollback is ready if needed (snapshot and rollback script tested).

oliver: Investigating redis keys; found env var `CACHE_TTL` set to `30` instead of `300` in the k8s config for scale-prod. That explains evictions.

tara: I can patch the k8s var to `300` and re-run smoke. If approved, I'll apply the patch now.

sarah: Please patch and rerun smoke. coordinate with infra.

tara: Patch applied (`kubectl set env deploy/inference CACHE_TTL=300 -n prod`) and restarted pods (rolling). Running sample again...

tara: Sample run: latency back to baseline, p95 stable, 0 errors.

mike: Metrics trending back to normal after TTL fix. evictions dropped, write ops normalized. I'll keep a 15m watch.

tara: Did a small burst load test (100 rps for 30s) against the canary slice — CPU steady, no p99 spikes.

sarah: Great. Continue watch for next 60m. If anything critical, @oliver will trigger rollback. :thumbsup: 

oliver: Rollback playbook ready. Trigger criteria confirmed: >0.5% client errors or >20% sustained latency increase over baseline for 5m.

infra-runbook-bot: Handoff recorded — owners: [sarah, oliver, tara], watch_until: +60m from 1978501714.

sarah: Thanks everyone. Closing this thread for now. If you spot anything, reply here and we'll escalate.
